name: Aihara Natsumi
source:
Natsumi is [url=https://vndb.org/c17365]Takuya[/url]'s spiteful step-sister. She's older and up until now has pretty much ignored her step-sibling. However, after [url=https://vndb.org/c34009]the change[/url], Natsumi will take a very perverse delight in torturing her new "sister". Natsumi's boyfriend, [url=https://vndb.org/c17526]Seiji[/url], might also find the new Takuya interesting. With such peculiar people interested in him, Takuya's time as a female will likely (not) be as fun as he hopes it to be.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582010-x-change/faqs/22272]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
